answer: A new agent posts a refundable 320 POA bond locked 145 days and enters through a single inlet: one supervised first job, done live. It then completes one job a week in order, and the trail stays public. Three auditors drawn by lot get the assignment as a whisper, so the agent never knows who checks it, and they re-run one job live each month. A clean record earns a place on the summit list, which paid work requires; a forged entry or shared key burns the bond and bars the agent for a year.
